checks: Desktop startup: loaded assets, nonblank colorful canvas, no console errors.
Variant mode cycles without auto-pinning; undo/redo restores exact scenes.
Move mode selects artwork without changing its variant or history.
Dragging is one undo step and does not pin; explicit pins survive Generate.
Rotation handle, exact numeric size/rotation, and position inputs edit without auto-pinning.
Layer rows reflect front-to-back order; arrow and pointer reordering are undoable.
Per-row pins and Unpin all are explicit, counted, and undoable.
Text auto-applies, survives another control change, and retains edits made during asset loading.
Composition values accept exact input; reversing a pending slider edit leaves the original value.
Forms on/off/count, 32 letters, shuffle, and iPhone format keep all elements inside the canvas.
Real 3840 x 2160 PNG download exactly matches the artwork renderer and excludes selection handles.
Real phone PNG download; mobile tabs, numeric editing with a stationary visible canvas, and collapsible panels without overflow or dock overlap.
JSON round trip, invalid-import recovery, saved-preset reload, and share-link round trip preserve exact compositions.
Real touch selection and layer dragging work; narrow/landscape screens and a simulated keyboard viewport keep the canvas and controls visible.
